steps.en: OCMS receives the latest vehicle numbers per warrant ID from DOS
steps.id: OCMS menerima vehicle number terbaru per ID warrant dari DOS
steps.why_en: No connection to DOS exists, so no vehicle numbers are received.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada koneksi ke DOS, jadi tidak ada vehicle number yang diterima.

steps.en: OCMS picks the IDs that have outstanding warrants of arrest
steps.id: OCMS memilih ID yang punya warrant of arrest outstanding
steps.why_en: The court and warrant module is not built, so warrant IDs cannot be selected.
steps.why_id: Modul court dan warrant belum ada, jadi ID warrant tidak bisa dipilih.

steps.en: OCMS builds a daily vehicle file for enforcement
steps.id: OCMS membuat file kendaraan harian untuk enforcement
steps.why_en: A daily vehicle file exists but lists vehicles by notice suspension, not by warrant IDs.
steps.why_id: File kendaraan harian ada tetapi isinya dari status suspension notice, bukan ID warrant.

steps.en: OCMS sends the daily file to frontend enforcement
steps.id: OCMS mengirim file harian ke frontend enforcement
steps.why_en: Only one enforcement system gets a file, and it is not built from DOS data.
steps.why_id: Hanya satu sistem enforcement yang menerima file, dan isinya bukan dari data DOS.

steps.en: OCMS sends the daily file to EPS operators
steps.id: OCMS mengirim file harian ke EPS operator
steps.why_en: No delivery to EPS operators exists anywhere.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pengiriman ke EPS operator sama sekali.
